nom: ANUA KPop Demon Hunters Invisible Matte Finish Sunscreen

avis.texte: this is one of the best face sunscreens Ive ever used. It doesn't irritate my eyes and doesn't leave a greasy finish. Its soft and blurs the pores very well! Def going to be a regular for me now

avis.titre: I love the matte finish, but it's weird
avis.texte: Overall I like the product because I really want a sunscreen that doesn't make me look and feel greasy before I even start sweating, but it sits on top of my skin in such a way that when I lightly scratched and itch on my cheek hours after applying the product there was sunscreen caked under my nail. Otherwise it's nice for the price, I will use it but I don't think I will repurchase it.
wanted a new sunscreen that wouldnt break the bank. tried it out and i really like it!! definitely will be buying again!!
I had big hopes on this one… the texture is weird, like a primer, but that is okay. It gives you matte look, but after half of the day my skin is oily again! Will be returning

This sunscreen is fantastic. I have oily, sensitive, acne prone skin. This hasn't broken me out or irritated my skin at all. It keeps my skin matte and looking fantastic all day. It doesn't irritate my eyes like most other sunscreens do. I love it. I will say, it's a little stubborn getting off. Just double cleanse
I just discovered this after walking through Ulta. I'm in love with the finish. Blurring and Matte. So silky. Not greasy.

This is a great sunscreen for oily skin. It has a pump and I do enjoy that feature. I have very sensitive eyes and this doesn't cause irritation. I hope this is a staple in the Anua line as I plan to repurchase many times over!!

avis.titre: An oily acne prone girls dream!
avis.texte: This is my perfect sunscreen as an oily skinned, acne prone girly. I normally breakout with chemical sunscreen (even popular Korean ones like Beauty of Joeson), but this doesn't break me out. And most importantly doesn't make me oily. AND it actually works as a pore filling, makeup makeup primer. Tbh it works better as a maytifying makeup primer than a lot of other ones I've tried (smashbox, fenty), but dont it expect to be as mattifying as sowmthing like O/S oil sucker. I really hope this isnt limited edition.
The quality you get is AMAZING for the price!!! It looks/feels similar to the smashbox photo finish primer, but its a sunscreen! No weird smell or whitecast AT ALL. Highly recommend.
